issues.summary: Draft rule conflated AetherCore self-update failure with Windows Update servicing failure.
issues.resolution: Removed P17-CORR-002; future servicing correlation requires a genuine Windows Update fact source.

issues.summary: Sensitive/hardware remediation could be counted as optional optimization.
issues.resolution: Optional count now requires low/informational severity plus SafeAuto/SafeReview; result groups are mutually exclusive.

issues.summary: Collector worker spawn failure could disappear without a terminal collector status.
issues.resolution: Spawn failure now returns an explicit unavailable TaskResult and diagnostic limitation.

issues.summary: Reboot/reversibility enum values and raw limitation prose could leak English into Arabic primary UI.
issues.resolution: Mapped reboot/reversibility and collector terminal states to EN/AR keys; raw internal warnings are not used as primary limitation copy.

issues.summary: Default Deep Scan task count was six while coordinator schedules seven collector tasks.
issues.resolution: Default task count corrected to seven.

issues.summary: Rust/Cargo and installed UI dependencies are unavailable on the current host.
issues.resolution: No compile/test PASS is claimed; deterministic source/static/SQLite evidence is produced and native/toolchain gates remain explicit.

issues.summary: A low-risk finding could appear in both Recommended and Optional result groups.
issues.resolution: Grouping now uses disjoint sets: High/Critical is Needs Action; eligible low/informational low-risk remediation is Optional; remaining lower-severity findings are Recommended.

issues.summary: Finding lifecycle/history persistence failures could be ignored while the scan still appeared fully completed.
issues.resolution: Persistence failures now preserve current results but downgrade an otherwise completed scan to Partial and expose a localized continuity limitation.

issues.summary: The driver-regression rule initially had synthetic DriverChange evidence but no production normalization source.
issues.resolution: Recent verified driver-install journal entries are now queried with owner-principal scoping and normalized into DriverChange facts.

issues.summary: A non-selectable driver update offer could produce an executable InstallDriver remediation candidate before Phase 18 authority resolution.
issues.resolution: Non-selectable/non-vendor offers are informational with no remediation; vendor-managed offers are ManualVendorAction; InstallDriver is created only for selectable offers.

issues.summary: Counting all unreferenced facts as healthy could inflate Healthy checks with neutral inventory/history observations.
issues.resolution: Healthy count now uses explicit per-payload healthy predicates only.

issues.summary: CompletedWithWarnings could be rendered as failed and was not consistently included in the visible limitation count.
issues.resolution: CompletedWithWarnings has a dedicated localized label and is included in the limitation view/count without becoming a machine-health finding.

issues.summary: Adding the ninth Deep Scan surface and its filter controls regressed three existing Phase 0-16 static UI gates.
issues.resolution: Deep Scan filters now use fluidPress, the reduced-transparency rule no longer uses !important, and the legacy surface gate recognizes the Phase 17 ninth production surface while requiring all original eight. Re-run result: 342/342 PASS.

issues.summary: The Arabic Deep Scan Windows filter reused the English literal and failed the existing localization audit.
issues.resolution: Localized the visible filter label as ويندوز; technical Windows identifiers remain isolated as technical content.

issues.summary: The Zenith watcher audit hard-coded nine stream watchers and failed after the valid Deep Scan watcher became the tenth.
issues.resolution: The existing non-panicking spawn_watcher invariant is preserved for all watchers, and the gate now requires all ten including Deep Scan.
